author: Da_cake_dood
body: Hey dillpickel or whoever is seeing this. I'm appealing for a unban for void logging. On the map Senex, i was bridging and i place a block above the void. But there is always block lag in Avicus and i hated it as it will affect my kd. Feeling angry and pissed, I did /leave and re join back. dillpickel who was spectating the match saw me void log and temp ban me. yes, i know i'm wrong and i'm hoping you guys will unban me cause i love to play on avicus and the community.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello ItsCakeHD,

Combat logging is combat logging. It doesn't matter why you did it, you broke the rule. It's only 1 day, serve your time and don't do it again. This appeal is denied.

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
